flights.notes: Lands 23:55. Car desk after immigration puts you on the road ~00:40, hotel ~01:00. Day 1 departs 08:00 — that is a short night by design.
Different airline from the outbound — Wizz baggage allowance is stricter than LOT's, check before packing. Route reaches the airport 18:55, so ~5h spare.

car.model: Kia Sorento Plug-in Hybrid or similar
car.insurance: CONFIRM: gravel protection (GP) and sand & ash (SAAP) are the two that matter in Iceland and are usually extra.
car.notes: Pickup 01:00 is 65 min after the 23:55 landing — immigration, bags and the rental shuttle all have to fit in that. Plug-in hybrid: it runs on petrol regardless, so range is never a problem; charging is only a cost saving if a hotel has a plug. 'Or similar' means the PHEV is not guaranteed.
